difficulty

Tap a card, hear the story

Heat the pad and the pin together for two seconds. Feed solder into the joint, not onto the iron. Take the solder away first, then the iron.

Strip 3 mm, twist the strands, and tin the end before you solder it to a pad.

Unplug USB and disconnect any battery before you solder or change a wire. Work on a surface that does not burn, and wash your hands after handling solder.

34LYTT-WIRE-1

Before you switch it on

  1. Look. Every joint is a shiny cone. No solder touches a neighbouring pad. No stray strands of wire.
  2. These must not beep. Set the multimeter to continuity and probe each pair. A beep means a short: find it before you plug in.
    USBGND3VGND
  3. These must beep. Probe the two ends of every connection.
    USBD32 Pro USB · Amp VIN · Cap +
    GNDD32 Pro GND.2 · Amp GND · Cap -
    3VD32 Pro 3V · Reader 3.3V · Knob + · Pull-up 1
    GNDD32 Pro GND · Reader GND · Knob GND · Next 2 · Prev 2 · Play 2
    RFID_CSD32 Pro 21 · Reader SDA
    RFID_SCKD32 Pro 14 · Reader SCK
    RFID_MOSID32 Pro 13 · Reader MOSI
    RFID_MISOD32 Pro 15 · Reader MISO
    I2S_DOUTD32 Pro 25 · Amp DIN
    I2S_BCLKD32 Pro 27 · Amp BCLK
    I2S_LRCD32 Pro 26 · Amp LRC
    amp_SPK+Amp SPK+ · Speaker +
    amp_SPK-Amp SPK- · Speaker -
    ENCODER_CLKD32 Pro 34 · Knob CLK
    ENCODER_DTD32 Pro VN · Knob DT
    ENCODER_BUTTOND32 Pro 32 · Knob SW
    NEXT_BUTTOND32 Pro 33 · Next 1
    PREVIOUS_BUTTOND32 Pro 2 · Prev 1
    PAUSEPLAY_BUTTOND32 Pro VP · Play 1 · Pull-up 2
  4. Plug in. Nothing gets warm, nothing smells. If something does, unplug at once and go back to step 2.
  5. Flash the bring-up test. It reports every part it can find before you load the real firmware.pio run -e bringup -t upload && pio device monitor
35LYTT-WIRE-1

Lytt is built

Lytt is a box that plays an album, an audiobook or a web radio station when you lay an RFID card on its lid. It runs the open-source ESPuino firmware on a LOLIN D32 Pro (ESP32-WROVER with PSRAM), plays from a microSD card through a small class-D amplifier, and has a volume knob and three buttons, no screen. It is built for an experienced hobbyist with a soldering iron and a 3D printer.
